verdict.rationale: The evidence pack for Fedora Workstation contains no documentation or first-party claims of built-in window snapping/tiling layouts; the only related comment (fedora-comm-5) praises 'native tiling support' but explicitly refers to the KDE Spin, not the default GNOME-based Fedora Workstation this pack describes. No mainstream evidence shows Workstation itself shipping predefined tiling layouts.
